nodes.author: MichaelEdw562
nodes.text: This time, it’s a virus called HMPV. It usually causes mild cold symptoms, but it’s hitting hard with pneumonia cases, especially in kids. China’s now scrambling with a ‘monitoring system.’ Like, shouldn’t they have done this before things got this bad? 2/4

nodes.author: MichaelEdw562
nodes.text: And while we’re at it, the WHO is still asking China for proper data about COVID’s origins. Remember the lab leak theory? China keeps denying it, but let’s be real- are we buying their story? 3/4

nodes.author: MichaelEdw562
nodes.text: Once again, China’s lack of transparency is putting everyone on edge. They keep repeating the same mistakes, and the world keeps paying the price. Stay safe, folks. This isn’t the time to let our guard down. 4/4
